Beacon spot-checks plus a heartbeat stop bulk fakes: each proves its work, and no operator can fake a thousand pulses across the canyon from claim to proof.

An identity posts a 25-unit bond, an ivory token. The beacon samples at random; the tide of checks follows its schedule, never the attacker's. A miss burns 5 units.

Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 units plus 1,000 heartbeats; one honest agent pays 25 once, keeps its reward.
